name: SVC_MILESTONE_CONFIGS
description: This table will be used to store milestone configuration details along with start, stop and pause conditions. These conditions will be used to derive the SLA values for the service request.

columns.name: MILESTONE_CONFIG_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: BU_ORG_ID
columns.description: Stores the Business Unit Org Id of the Milestone Configuration.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the milestone configurations are logically deleted or not.(Y or N)

columns.name: DISABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the milestone configuration is disabled or not

columns.name: MILESTONE_CODE
columns.description: The code defined in contracts object for each milestone.

columns.name: MILESTONE_LABEL
columns.description: User defined display label for each milestone.

columns.name: MILESTONE_TYPE
columns.description: Milestone type indicates whether the milestone can have multiple instances, reopenable etc.

columns.name: THRESHOLD_CODE
columns.description: The code defined in contracts object for each threshold.

columns.name: START_CONDITION
columns.description: This column will store the exact SQL expression for the start condition

columns.name: START_CONDITION_LABEL
columns.description: Stores description for the rule expression which defines the Start Status

columns.name: PAUSE_CONDITION
columns.description: This column will store the exact SQL expression for the pause condition

columns.name: PAUSE_CONDITION_LABEL
columns.description: Stores description for the rule expression which defines the pause Status

columns.name: STOP_CONDITION
columns.description: This column will store the exact SQL expression for the stop condition

columns.name: STOP_CONDITION_LABEL
columns.description: Stores description for the rule expression which defines the stop Status

columns.name: ALLOW_DUE_DATE_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether an agent can override milestone due date or not.

columns.name: ALLOW_AGENT_COMPLETION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether an agent can mark milestone as complete or not.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the object to which this milestone is associated.

columns.name: TZ_PREFERENCE_CD
columns.description: Indicates the object name from which time zone has to be picked.
